purpose: Review and commit breakdown only; no files staged, no commits created, no push performed.

commits.title: Enforce tenant ownership and reliable notification delivery
commits.scope: Sync write locking and conflict ownership, booking/pet/resource and billing references, table-policy inventory, active-member push scoping, provider HTTP failure propagation.
commits.validation_and_staging: Run scoping, sync-upload, booking/billing reference and notification tests. TABLE_POLICIES is a declaration guard, not database RLS; do not describe it as completed backend hardening.

commits.title: Correct package taxes and historical ledger posting
commits.scope: Package tax-class calculation, Nova Scotia rate fixture/expectation, dated ledger reversals, disputes, payouts, earnings and owned idempotent package consumption.
commits.validation_and_staging: Run tax, invoice, package, ledger and earnings tests. Extract finance regression tests that do not depend on the new seed; defer seed-dependent tests to 06.

commits.title: Add shared booking controls and improve component rendering
commits.scope: ActionTile, DayRail, OptionCard and SlotChips twins/stories/contracts; avatar images, document branding primitives, modal accessibility and tab sizing.
commits.validation_and_staging: Run UI typechecks and playground tests. Pair exports, interfaces, copy and stories. Keep PaymentAccount and payment SDK changes for 05.

commits.title: Expand Connect profiles booking and order fulfillment
commits.scope: Public profiles, returning-client verification, availability and manage messaging, variants, pickup windows/preparation/tracking/cancellation/reminders, public page redesign and embed behavior, business branding and letterheads.
commits.validation_and_staging: Include migrations cbconnect01 through cbconnect04 in order; models, server-only policies, API/sync generation, worker registration, tests and client consumers together. Include pending-refund helpers required by order cancellation, even though they share the payment service.

commits.title: Add embedded payment accounts and client bank authorization
commits.scope: Embedded Connect accounts, safe account descriptors, bank setup links and mandate reconciliation, pending/failed refund semantics and notification opt-out, payment forms, payouts UI and terminal lifecycle.
commits.validation_and_staging: Include cbpayments01 then cbpayments02, provider protocol/fakes/contract tests, PaymentAccount twins/story, WebView/Connect dependencies and lockfile. Run payment/PAD/refund tests, payment-account browser test and native payment walkthroughs.

commits.title: Seed realistic ordinary accounts in the main development database
commits.scope: Modular seed with realistic schedules, finances, identity, engagement and assets; scoped reset and validation; main-database commands; CI object storage; fixture-dependent test adjustments.
commits.validation_and_staging: Run fresh migration/seed in a disposable test environment and demo-check, all seed tests and the backend suite. Keep integration fakes test-only. Do not include scratch databases, dumps or local secrets.

commits.title: Require authenticated sync and handle business loading reliably
commits.scope: Remove development sync-auth bypass and demo login hints; share business loading/error/empty state between web and mobile; authentication browser regression tests.
commits.validation_and_staging: Run sync-auth/harness and auth browser tests, including fresh signup, populated accounts and failed sync. Split useBusinessLoad and App.tsx changes from branding/navigation.

commits.title: Make Inbox a primary mobile destination and repair navigation
commits.scope: Inbox tab and attention targets, shared inbox resolver and tests, mobile Today actions, payment navigation, notification routing and related native regressions.
commits.validation_and_staging: Run messaging resolver tests and native inbox/navigation regressions on the existing iOS simulator and Android. Split App.tsx from 07 and payment-specific copy from 05.

commits.title: Add repeatable product-surface end-to-end coverage
commits.scope: Web/Connect walkthroughs and runner artifacts, native Maestro suite and commands, development endpoint overrides, lint exclusions for generated test reports.
commits.validation_and_staging: Run web, Connect, playground and native suites against test fixtures. DEMO_E2E=1 is required for demo.e2e.ts; default execution skips it. Re-run documented native regressions rather than treating walkthrough success as full coverage.

commits.title: Align marketing examples and payment disclosures
commits.scope: Generated marketing fixture snapshot, site examples/copy, payment disclosures and sitemap XML/lastmod correction.
commits.validation_and_staging: Run snapshot freshness verification, site content lint, site tests and production build. Legal/pricing placeholders still need separate launch completion; this commit does not constitute legal review.

commits.title: Organize engineering reviews and execution records
commits.scope: Core documentation updates, review/execution/exploration directories and port-plan move, project workflow instructions and this commit inventory.
commits.validation_and_staging: Verify relative links, remove stale active-database instructions and distinguish historical evidence from current results. Retain incomplete backend tasks as incomplete; exclude ignored scratchpad artifacts.

staging_rules: Primary file lists are ownership inventories, not blanket git-add instructions. staged_sections and fixture_note override whole-file staging.
Keep all six migrations linear: cbconnect01 -> cbconnect02 -> cbconnect03 -> cbconnect04 -> cbpayments01 -> cbpayments02.

Regenerate API/sync artifacts against each staged feature state in a temporary checkout, not the final dirty tree; include results with that feature. Never postpone required types to a final generated-files commit.
Apply provider protocol and matching fake changes together. Stage exact dependency/lockfile changes with the payment SDK consumer.

Check every intermediate commit from a clean checkout with its own migrated/seeded test environment. If a boundary cannot pass without later hunks, move prerequisites earlier or merge commits; do not knowingly create broken intermediate commits.
No stash/reset of shared working tree. Recheck hashes before staging because another session is editing. Keep backups, test reports, local keys and database files ignored.

After the stack is assembled run the full gate and browser/native checks, fetch origin, and review both the existing 76 commits and new commits before a normal push. No history rewrite or force push is proposed.

plan_file_commit: 11; plan itself is excluded from snapshot hashes to avoid a self-referential checksum
shared_file_cautions: Connect commit 04 is the largest cohesive slice (90 primary files). Its booking, returning-client and shop pages share public schemas, branded shells and migration dependencies. Split further only after validating intermediate staged states; the current whole-file diffs are not independent.
Include all imports/exports needed by partial-stage edits. For ui.ts, strings.ts, index barrels, generated.ts and schema.ts, never stage the entire final file early.

CardForm returnUrl and payment-method form behavior belong in 05 with PublicPaymentSetup. If a Connect page staged in 04 consumes a new prop, move the minimal prop implementation to 03 or defer that consuming hunk to 05.

For backend tests, seed fixture updates coexist with security and payment assertions. Assemble test changes against the seed version present at that commit instead of blindly staging entire changed test files.
